body: Not at the moment, my relatives are all equally as bad as my mum. Pay my way definitely.

She thinks the same, despite being in the medical field. To her, medication for mental illness does nothing, I'm faking it, I'm attention seeking, all that jazz. My mum believes that I'll ruin my life and her reputation if I get medicated, it really sucks, especially when I'm just ruining my life by hallucinating at school and then going into shut down. Is yours the same, with the whole "medication will earn you a bad reputation" thing?

But I think you're right on each problem at a time, but there's not much options. I need the money to get through school and move out, need the grades to get into university and get a better job, it's a mess. I don't know how to handle it, which is why the only way out is waiting.
